requirements.quote: `/home/user/project/update_log.txt` exists and follows the exact format described above with precisely two entries.
Each line must follow the pattern (no extra spaces):

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import re,sys,datetime
ls=open('"'"'/home/user/project/update_log.txt'"'"').read().splitlines()
ok=len(ls)==2

    m=re.fullmatch(r'"'"'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}) - ADDED [A-Za-z0-9_]+'"'"',l)
    ok=ok and bool(m)
    if m: datetime.datetime.strptime(m.group(1),'"'"'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'"'"')
